method: Parse actual npm build/types public barrels with TypeScript AST; compare release source barrels and npm build/esm runtime exports. No component imports executed.
notes: Stable subpath does not imply product GA.
Aliases and experimental aggregate repeat symbols; unique symbol counts deduplicate by kind:name.
Wildcard export is only valid for present public files; internal build paths are not public contracts.
styles.css is a CSS asset, not a JavaScript symbol entry.
